程序包 org.bukkit

接口 SoundGroup

public interface SoundGroup
表示方块的声音组，当各种动作发生时播放（例如踩踏、破坏、击打等）。

原文： Represents a group of sounds for blocks that are played when various actions happen (ie stepping, breaking, hitting, etc).

    • getVolume

      float getVolume()
      获取这些声音的播放音量。 请注意，此音量并不总是代表客户端接收的实际音量。

      原文： Get the volume these sounds are played at. Note that this volume does not always represent the actual volume received by the client.

      返回:
      音量。 原文： Get the volume these sounds are played at. Note that this volume does not always represent the actual volume received by the client.

      原文：volume
